title: Data reasoning method and device, equipment and storage medium
assignee: Guangdong Oppo Mobile Telecommunications Corp Ltd

pse.problem: Limited flexibility in terminal-side training during federated learning leads to problems affecting model performance
pse.solution_function: The system provides a data inference method that allows terminal devices to train an initial model based on their own target data through TFLite, improving the flexibility of terminal-side training and further enhancing model performance
pse.solution_structure: Terminal device includes an acquisition module and a processing module. The network device provides the initial model. Optionally, the data reasoning device may include a processor, memory, and communication interface.
pse.solution_implementation: The acquisition module acquires target data. The processing module inputs the target data into an algorithm model (obtained by TFLite training the initial model based on training data from the network device) and outputs the inference content of the target data
pse.effect: Improved flexibility of terminal-side training leads to enhanced model performance
